problems.title: House Robber
problems.description: You are a professional robber planning to rob houses along a street. Each house has a certain amount of money stashed. The constraint is that adjacent houses have security systems that will alert police if both are robbed.
problems.keyInsight: Use DP where dp[i] = max(nums[i] + dp[i-2], dp[i-1])

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.description: Given coins of different denominations and a total amount, return the fewest number of coins needed to make up that amount. Return -1 if impossible.
problems.keyInsight: Classic DP: For each amount, find minimum coins using available denominations

problems.title: Unique Paths II
problems.description: A robot at top-left of m x n grid tries to reach bottom-right. Can only move down or right. Some squares have obstacles (marked 1). Find number of unique paths.
problems.keyInsight: 2D DP with obstacle checking - paths blocked by obstacles are 0

problems.title: Edit Distance
problems.description: Given two strings word1 and word2, return the minimum number of operations to convert word1 to word2. Operations: insert, delete, or replace a character.
problems.keyInsight: Levenshtein distance - 2D DP table tracking min operations for each substring pair

problems.title: Binary Gap
problems.description: Given a positive integer n, find the longest distance between any two adjacent 1's in the binary representation. Return 0 if no two adjacent 1's exist.
problems.keyInsight: Track positions of 1's in binary representation, calculate max gap

problems.title: Reverse Linked List II
problems.description: Given head of singly linked list and two integers left and right, reverse the nodes from position left to position right and return the reversed list.
problems.keyInsight: Use dummy node, keep moving nodes to head of reversed section

problems.title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
problems.description: Given array of positive integers and target, return minimal length of subarray whose sum is >= target. Return 0 if no such subarray exists.
problems.keyInsight: Sliding window - expand right when sum < target, contract left when sum >= target

problems.title: Minimum Genetic Mutation
problems.description: Gene strings are 8-char strings with A/C/G/T. Find minimum mutations from startGene to endGene where all intermediate mutations must be in the gene bank. Return -1 if impossible.
problems.keyInsight: BFS to find shortest path through valid gene mutations

problems.title: Triangle
problems.description: Given a triangle array, return minimum path sum from top to bottom. For each step, may move to adjacent number of row below (index i or i+1).
problems.keyInsight: Bottom-up DP working backwards from bottom row
